name: luxury-lounge-black-dress-girl
image_purpose: Restaurant lounge and evening fashion social content

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic portrait in a dim upscale lounge or restaurant interior.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with long voluminous wavy light-brown hair in a side part, fair complexion, soft glamorous makeup and defined lips. She wears a chic strapless black mini dress with a textured ruched bodice, a gold wristwatch and gold chain bracelet, and has a visible black geometric tattoo on her right forearm.
